hotel_name: The Lodge & Spa at Brush Creek Ranch

claims.text: The Lodge & Spa is set between the Sierra Madre mountain range and Medicine Bow National Forest, minutes from the town of Saratoga.

findings.quote: set between the ancient Sierra Madre mountain range and stunning Medicine Bow National Forest, just minutes from the remote town of Saratoga

claims.text: Brush Creek Ranch is a working cattle ranch on 30,000 acres of sagebrush prairie and rolling hills in Wyoming's North Platte River Valley.

findings.quote: Located on 30,000 acres of sagebrush prairie and rolling hills in Wyoming's North Platte River Valley, this working cattle ranch is a nature-focused retreat

claims.text: The ranch is surrounded by more than 2 million acres of Medicine Bow-Routt National Forest.

findings.quote: surrounded by more than 2 million acres of Medicine Bow-Routt National Forest

claims.text: The Lodge & Spa is the original destination within the Brush Creek Luxury Ranch Collection.

findings.quote: The original destination within the Brush Creek Luxury Ranch Collection, the Lodge & Spa is located

claims.text: The western-style accommodations pay homage to the design and architecture of the original homestead, built in 1884.

findings.quote: Western-style accommodations pay homage to the old west design and architecture of the original homestead, built in 1884

claims.text: Private luxury log cabins range from one to four bedrooms.

findings.quote: 26 private, luxury log cabins ranging from 1- to 4-bedrooms

claims.text: Accommodations feature touches like stone fireplaces, cowhide chairs, fur throws, antler chandeliers and vaulted timber ceilings.

findings.quote: Touches like stone fireplaces, knotty wood furniture, dark leather couches, cowhide chairs, fur throws, antler chandeliers, vaulted timber ceilings

claims.text: The Trailhead Spa offers massages and facials, and has a sauna and steam room.

findings.quote: our premier spa is ready to pamper you with everything from massages to facial services
